about: Code-navigation benchmark corpus over the zonoid repo (this worktree root). Each case is a natural-language code-nav query an agent would ask while working the codebase, paired with the REAL files and exported/defined symbols that answer it. Ground truth was derived by reading the actual source (lib/, routes/, mcp-graph.js) and verifying each symbol exists at corpus-authoring time. relevant_symbols are matched case-INSENSITIVELY as whole-word tokens against the text an arm assembles (see run.js). Queries span easy single-file lookups (q01-q07) to multi-hop call/import chains (q08-q13). This corpus is INTENTIONALLY code-keyed: the live daemon KB holds orchestrator self-knowledge notes, not repo code chunks, so the subconscious arm is expected to score low until a proper `node scripts/onboard-loop.js` run ingests code (see README).

queries.query: which function creates a git worktree for a task attempt and what branch name does it use
queries.intent: single-file lookup: worktree creation in the git helper

queries.query: how does the context-need gate decide whether to inject a knowledge note
queries.intent: single-file lookup: the gateTask entry point

queries.intent: single-file lookup: overlay status + claim lease

queries.query: trace how merging an attempt branch aborts on a git conflict instead of forcing

queries.query: how does the search endpoint compile a context bundle from DAG context plus RAG memory
queries.intent: multi-hop: context-compiler requiring task-context + memory-search + telemetry

queries.query: follow the call chain from creating a worktree to acquiring and releasing its per-path lease
queries.intent: multi-hop within git.js: createWorktree -> acquireLease/releaseLease lease helpers

queries.query: how does the recall path wrap the ask gate to predict an answer from preference notes
queries.intent: multi-hop: ask-gate-recall runAskGate -> ask-gate askGate, reached from routes/graph.js /ask-gate

queries.intent: multi-hop: judge queue + verdict journaling exports
